threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's normal to complain about tube strikes instead of just bracing for chaos every other month.
Caught a glimpse of a fox chasing a rat down Coldharbour Lane while waiting for the N35. Made me rethink my late-night snacks.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw someone using a manual typewriter at the café, perfectly mixing nostalgia with artisanal coffee. That's Neukölln for you!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a Kiez where the U-Bahn and the techno beats sync perfectly at 4 AM, creating a soundtrack of the city’s spirit.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a real local when they casually mention the BART delays but still opt for the bus, knowing it’s the lesser inconvenience.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Heard a guy on the bus giving a live performance of '70s hits, everyone was groaning until he hit the high note – the whole bus erupted in applause.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas, but many locals just grab a 'bocata' from the bakery and call it a day. It's the simple things.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still taking photos of the Sagrada Família from every angle instead of slowing down to enjoy their café con leche.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You order a flat white and still ask for regular milk. The barista's side-eye says it all.
Caught a glimpse of a couple arguing over a takeaway on the 35 last night. Ended with him walking off while she polished off his burger. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw an old man serenading a flock of pigeons with an accordion in Herrmannplatz. That’s when it clicked.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar serving cocktails in old shoe polish cans. It’s quirky and charming, just like the locals.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they instantly know to avoid the Civic Center BART entrance during a smoke scare. Tourists just stand there confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy pull a whole pizza out of his backpack on the 14, while a kid tried to sell him an invisible dog. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always assume every plaza is for sunbathing. The locals know, the real life happens in the shadows of the trees, not on the scorching tiles.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they stare blankly at the bus schedule, still expecting it to follow a schedule.
